name: Encarmine
source: Encarmine is a gothic fantasy/adventure game featuring stark pulp visuals about Lucia and Maurus, two friends tracking a wayward spirit across the countryside. Play through two parallel campaigns to experience the complete story.
translation: 《Encarmine》是一款哥特幻想冒险游戏，以鲜明的通俗小说风格画面讲述露西亚与毛鲁斯的故事。两位朋友在乡间追踪一个失控的灵体。通过两条平行战役，你将体验完整剧情。
